fusions.name: Herd Surge
fusions.desc: You surge ahead through a cone up to 4 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Flank Nudge
fusions.desc: A shouldering nudge that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bedded Down Together
fusions.desc: Beds down a warm patch where you stand for 10 seconds, restoring 3 health a second to you and every ally inside its 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Herd Body Heat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
